definition.confirmed: CONFIRMED iff meanNetR > +0.10R AND day-clustered tNet > 2 AND excessVsRandomR > 0 AND day-clustered t > 2 AND all vetoes clear: n >= 100, concentration <= 0.50, LOYO >= 0.75, NO_BASELINE.
definition.trueNetEdge: Evaluated at true net edges 0R, 0.05R, 0.10R, 0.15R, 0.20R and 0.30R.
definition.probability: Parametric Monte Carlo full-conjunction rate over 10000 runs per cell/edge; report-only.

rule.frozenConjunction: mean net R > +0.10R AND day-clustered tNet > 2 AND excess vs matched random > 0 AND day-clustered tExcess > 2 AND n >= 100 AND concentration <= 0.50 AND LOYO >= 0.75 AND NO_BASELINE clear
rule.source: scripts/map-compass/frozen.mjs CLAIM_CRITERIA and lib/verification.mjs verifyClaim; unchanged
rule.analyticalNetCrossCheck: P(meanNet > 0.10 AND tNet > 2) = Phi((edge - max(0.10, 2*SE))/SE), with SE = measured baseline SD * measured CR1 inflation / sqrt(Kish nEffective).

requestedPooledPowerConstraint.explanation: The requested pooled probability >= every session probability cannot hold over the full edge grid while the +0.10R absolute-mean floor is frozen. For true edge 0 or 0.05R, smaller session samples can have a greater chance of crossing the +0.10R threshold by noise; as pooled n increases, that false-confirmation probability approaches zero. No thresholds were altered to force the requested relation. The report checks pooled >= each session separately by edge; at/above 0.10R, higher-n pooled power should dominate within simulation error.
requestedPooledPowerConstraint.mathematicalCheck: For edge μ<0.10 and SE→0, P(mean estimate>0.10)→0, whereas at finite session SE it is strictly positive.

method.counts: measured card-specific one-slot survivors in slot-model.json; each verdict-state/session n exactly equals the sum of its contributing card-specific kept counts
method.sessions: actual signal session at each kept entry; no equal split
method.pooled: pooled n equals the sum of the three session n; same EAT calendar dates are clustered together
method.dependence: Kish effective N is computed over duplicate kept entry bars across cards; CR1 inflation is measured on baseline trades by verdict state; power uses their combined SE correction
method.baseline: fine baseline means and SDs weighted by their observed random-entry counts for matching verdict state/session across side and vol cells
method.yearVetoSimulation: parametric year-level Gaussian contributions use measured per-year kept-trade counts; LOYO positive share and concentration are evaluated with frozen cutoffs
method.limitations: This aggregate planning calculation combines separately tested card observations. It is not a forecast for any one family/card; card/family results remain unverified and require M6 per-card trade production.

note: REPORT-ONLY. No strategy verification or card freeze. No thresholds, Map, costs, exit, or CONFIRMED rule changed.
